items.name: prism-glass
items.title: Prism Glass
items.description: A GPU-accelerated refractive lens for images and rendered textures. Spectral dispersion, uniform frost and a directional rim light, from an SDF-defined shape — no 3D model required. It refracts the texture you give it, not the DOM behind it.

items.name: ascii-field
items.title: ASCII Field
items.description: A canvas field of glyphs that scramble around the cursor and settle back to rest.
